package course

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

const maximumResponseBytes = 2 << 20

type Client struct {
	BaseURL       string
	InternalToken string
	HTTPClient    *http.Client
}

type lessonContextResponse struct {
	LessonID        string `json:"lesson_id"`
	CourseID        string `json:"course_id"`
	SectionID       string `json:"section_id"`
	Language        string `json:"language"`
	Title           string `json:"title"`
	Excerpt         string `json:"excerpt"`
	Description     string `json:"description"`
	ContentRevision string `json:"content_revision"`
}

func (client Client) GetLessonContext(ctx context.Context, lessonID, language string) (domain.CourseLessonContent, error) {
	lessonID = strings.TrimSpace(lessonID)
	language = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(language))
	if lessonID == "" || len(language) > 35 {
		return domain.CourseLessonContent{}, domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext
	}
	endpoint, err := client.endpoint("/internal/lesson/" + url.PathEscape(lessonID) + "/teacher-context")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.CourseLessonContent{}, err
	}
	parsed, err := url.Parse(endpoint)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.CourseLessonContent{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	query := parsed.Query()
	query.Set("language", language)
	parsed.RawQuery = query.Encode()
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, parsed.String(), nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.CourseLessonContent{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.CourseLessonContent{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	switch response.StatusCode {
	case http.StatusOK:
	case http.StatusNotFound, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity:
		return domain.CourseLessonContent{}, domain.ErrLessonContextNotFound
	default:
		return domain.CourseLessonContent{}, unavailable(fmt.Errorf("unexpected Course response %s", response.Status))
	}
	var payload lessonContextResponse
	if err := decodeStrict(response.Body, &payload); err != nil {
		return domain.CourseLessonContent{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	payload.LessonID = strings.TrimSpace(payload.LessonID)
	payload.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(payload.CourseID)
	payload.SectionID = strings.TrimSpace(payload.SectionID)
	revision, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, strings.TrimSpace(payload.ContentRevision))
	payload.Language = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(payload.Language))
	if err != nil || payload.LessonID != lessonID || uuid.Validate(payload.CourseID) != nil ||
		(payload.SectionID != "" && uuid.Validate(payload.SectionID) != nil) ||
		payload.Language == "" || len(payload.Language) > 35 ||
		strings.TrimSpace(payload.Title) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(payload.Description) == "" ||
		!utf8.ValidString(payload.Title) || !utf8.ValidString(payload.Excerpt) || !utf8.ValidString(payload.Description) {
		return domain.CourseLessonContent{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext)
	}
	return domain.CourseLessonContent{
		LessonID: payload.LessonID, CourseID: payload.CourseID, SectionID: payload.SectionID,
		Language: payload.Language, Title: payload.Title,
		Excerpt: payload.Excerpt, Description: payload.Description,
		ContentRevision: revision.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
	}, nil
}

func (client Client) endpoint(path string) (string, error) {
	baseURL := strings.TrimRight(strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL), "/")
	if baseURL == "" || strings.TrimSpace(client.InternalToken) == "" {
		return "", unavailable(errors.New("course service URL and internal token are required"))
	}
	parsed, err := url.ParseRequestURI(baseURL + path)
	if err != nil || parsed.Scheme == "" || parsed.Host == "" {
		return "", unavailable(errors.New("invalid course service URL"))
	}
	return parsed.String(), nil
}

func (client Client) do(request *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	httpClient := client.HTTPClient
	if httpClient == nil {
		httpClient = &http.Client{Timeout: 3 * time.Second}
	}
	response, err := httpClient.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, unavailable(err)
	}
	return response, nil
}

func decodeStrict(reader io.Reader, target any) error {
	limited := &io.LimitedReader{R: reader, N: maximumResponseBytes + 1}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(limited)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) || limited.N == 0 {
		return errors.New("invalid Course lesson context response")
	}
	return nil
}

func unavailable(cause error) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", domain.ErrLessonContextUnavailable, cause)
}

var _ repository.CourseLessonContextReader = Client{}
